staticTransformation: One exact known cutoutReady binding is validated: authored true remains unchanged; legacy false becomes true only for hash/decode-verified embedded assets. Matches successful-load settled image state and hides duplicate vector fallback/shadows. staticAssetPath is identity in SSR without window. No donor mutation or client app runtime.
deduplication: One embedded WebP per cutout per SVG, symbols preserve stretch/slice fit; local use references retain clip/opacity/blend and motion groups. 1 refreshed 1200x800 raster comparisons must be exact or differ in at most 16 channels by one 8-bit level (symbol sampling roundoff); per-scene measurements follow. Other outputs are retained byte-exact with their own source provenance.
method: Exact committed overhead SVG sources; existing trusted raster adapter derives fallback, square and OG outputs. Inline material externalization uses publish_overhead_inline_artwork.py; source material and camera unchanged.
publicationMethod: Reviewed overhead proof scenes are preserved as standalone self-contained SVGs. Inline article SVGs externalize only content-addressed, same-origin WebP materials to avoid duplicating them in prerendered HTML.
